description: What a datasheet's data is written as: its query, in the shape set-query takes, its one SQL statement, or its join and the steps after it, and its formats. Read it before you change a datasheet with previewReportDatasheetChanges: set-query replaces the whole query, so start from this one. For the picture of a Tableau view or Power BI page added with addReportDatasheets, it also lists the charts on it, which addReportDashboardElements adds as data. Only the report's editors may.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

datasheetId.description: One of this report's datasheets, by its `id` in `listReportDatasheets`.

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.
